roles/dataplex.admin.title: Dataplex Administrator
roles/dataplex.admin.desc: Full access to Dataplex Universal Catalog resources, except for catalog resources like entries and entry groups.

roles/dataplex.aspectTypeOwner.title: Dataplex Aspect Type Owner
roles/dataplex.aspectTypeOwner.desc: Grants access to creating and managing Aspect Types. Does not give the right to create/modify Entries.

roles/dataplex.aspectTypeUser.title: Dataplex Aspect Type User
roles/dataplex.aspectTypeUser.desc: Grants access to use Aspect Types to create/modify Entries with the corresponding aspects.

roles/dataplex.bindingAdmin.title: Dataplex Binding Administrator
roles/dataplex.bindingAdmin.desc: Full access on DataAttribute Binding resources.

roles/dataplex.catalogAdmin.title: Dataplex Catalog Admin
roles/dataplex.catalogAdmin.desc: Full access to catalog resources, including entries, entry groups, and glossaries.

roles/dataplex.catalogEditor.title: Dataplex Catalog Editor
roles/dataplex.catalogEditor.desc: Write access to catalog resources, including entries, entry groups, and glossaries. Cannot set IAM policies on resources.

roles/dataplex.catalogViewer.title: Dataplex Catalog Viewer
roles/dataplex.catalogViewer.desc: Read access to catalog resources, including entries, entry groups, and glossaries. Can view IAM policies on catalog resources.

roles/dataplex.contentAdmin.title: Dataplex Content Admin
roles/dataplex.contentAdmin.desc: Grants full lifecycle ownership, IAM sharing (getIamPolicy/setIamPolicy), context entry management, curation specification updates, and deletion rights on a specific Context Set.

roles/dataplex.contentCreator.title: Dataplex Content Creator
roles/dataplex.contentCreator.desc: Authorizes users to create new Context Sets within a project.

roles/dataplex.contentEditor.title: Dataplex Content Editor
roles/dataplex.contentEditor.desc: Authorizes context engineers, curators, and agents to modify context entries, author guidelines, and update curation specifications without administrative IAM sharing or container deletion capabilities.

roles/dataplex.contentUser.title: Dataplex Content User
roles/dataplex.contentUser.desc: Authorizes consumers, business analysts, and 1P/3P AI agents to read context entries and documentation within specific Context Sets, and to submit feedback or modification proposals.

roles/dataplex.contentViewer.title: Dataplex Content Viewer
roles/dataplex.contentViewer.desc: Enables discovery of content containers (Context Sets) within a project or catalog without granting access to the underlying sensitive context entries.

roles/dataplex.dataOwner.title: Dataplex Data Owner
roles/dataplex.dataOwner.desc: Owner access to data. To be granted to Dataplex Universal Catalog resources Lake, Zone or Asset only.

roles/dataplex.dataProductsConsumer.title: Dataplex Data Products Consumer
roles/dataplex.dataProductsConsumer.desc: Restricted read access, intended for consumers of Data Products.

roles/dataplex.dataReader.title: Dataplex Data Reader
roles/dataplex.dataReader.desc: Read only access to data. To be granted to Dataplex Universal Catalog resources Lake, Zone or Asset only.

roles/dataplex.dataScanCreator.title: Dataplex DataScan Creator
roles/dataplex.dataScanCreator.desc: Access to create new DataScan resources.

roles/dataplex.dataScanDataViewer.title: Dataplex DataScan DataViewer
roles/dataplex.dataScanDataViewer.desc: Read access to DataScan resources, including the results.

roles/dataplex.dataScanViewer.title: Dataplex DataScan Viewer
roles/dataplex.dataScanViewer.desc: Read access to DataScan resources, excluding the results.

roles/dataplex.dataWriter.title: Dataplex Data Writer
roles/dataplex.dataWriter.desc: Write access to data. To be granted to Dataplex Universal Catalog resources Lake, Zone or Asset only.

roles/dataplex.developer.title: Dataplex Developer
roles/dataplex.developer.desc: Allows running data analytics workloads in a lake.

roles/dataplex.discoveryBigLakePublishin.title: Dataplex Discovery BigLake Publishing Service Agent
roles/dataplex.discoveryBigLakePublishin.desc: Gives the Dataplex Discovery Service Agent permissions to use bigquery connection.

roles/dataplex.discoveryPublishingServic.title: Dataplex Discovery Publishing Service Agent
roles/dataplex.discoveryPublishingServic.desc: Gives the Dataplex Discovery Service Agent dataset create and get permissions.

roles/dataplex.discoveryServiceAgent.title: Dataplex Discovery Service Agent
roles/dataplex.discoveryServiceAgent.desc: Gives the Dataplex Discovery Service Agent bucket read permissions.

roles/dataplex.editor.title: Dataplex Editor
roles/dataplex.editor.desc: Write access to Dataplex Universal Catalog resources, except for catalog resources like entries, entry groups, and glossaries.

roles/dataplex.encryptionAdmin.title: Dataplex Encryption Admin
roles/dataplex.encryptionAdmin.desc: Gives user permissions to manage encryption configurations.

roles/dataplex.entryGroupExporter.title: Dataplex Entry Group Exporter
roles/dataplex.entryGroupExporter.desc: Grants access to export this entry group for Metadata Job processing.

roles/dataplex.entryGroupImporter.title: Dataplex Entry Group Importer
roles/dataplex.entryGroupImporter.desc: Grants access to import this entry group for Metadata Job processing.

roles/dataplex.entryGroupOwner.title: Dataplex Entry Group Owner
roles/dataplex.entryGroupOwner.desc: Owns Entry Groups and Entries inside of them.

roles/dataplex.entryLinkTypeOwner.title: Dataplex Entry Link Type Owner
roles/dataplex.entryLinkTypeOwner.desc: Grants access to creating and managing Entry Link Types. Does not give the right to create/modify Entry Links.

roles/dataplex.entryLinkTypeUser.title: Dataplex Entry Link Type User
roles/dataplex.entryLinkTypeUser.desc: Grants access to use Entry Link Types to create EntryLinks of those types.

roles/dataplex.entryTypeOwner.title: Dataplex Entry Type Owner
roles/dataplex.entryTypeOwner.desc: Grants access to creating and managing Entry Types. Does not give the right to create/modify Entries.

roles/dataplex.entryTypeUser.title: Dataplex Entry Type User
roles/dataplex.entryTypeUser.desc: Grants access to use Entry Types to create/modify Entries of those types.

roles/dataplex.metadataFeedOwner.title: Dataplex Metadata Feed Owner
roles/dataplex.metadataFeedOwner.desc: Grants access to creating and managing Metadata Feeds. Does not give the right to create/modify Entry Groups.

roles/dataplex.metadataFeedViewer.title: Dataplex Metadata Feed Viewer
roles/dataplex.metadataFeedViewer.desc: Read access to Metadata Feed resources.

roles/dataplex.metadataJobOwner.title: Dataplex Metadata Job Owner
roles/dataplex.metadataJobOwner.desc: Grants access to creating and managing Metadata Jobs. Does not give the right to create/modify Entry Groups.

roles/dataplex.metadataJobViewer.title: Dataplex Metadata Job Viewer
roles/dataplex.metadataJobViewer.desc: Read access to Metadata Job resources.

roles/dataplex.metadataReader.title: Dataplex Metadata Reader
roles/dataplex.metadataReader.desc: Read only access to metadata within table and fileset entities and partitions.

roles/dataplex.metadataWriter.title: Dataplex Metadata Writer
roles/dataplex.metadataWriter.desc: Write and read access to metadata within table and fileset entities and partitions.

roles/dataplex.securityAdmin.title: Dataplex Security Administrator
roles/dataplex.securityAdmin.desc: Permissions configure ResourceAccess and DataAccess Specs on Data Attributes.

roles/dataplex.serviceAgent.title: Cloud Dataplex Service Agent
roles/dataplex.serviceAgent.desc: Gives the Dataplex service account access to project resources. This access will be used in data discovery, data management and data workload management.

roles/dataplex.storageDataOwner.title: Dataplex Storage Data Owner
roles/dataplex.storageDataOwner.desc: Owner access to data. Should not be used directly. This role is granted by Dataplex to managed resources like Cloud Storage buckets, BigQuery datasets etc.

roles/dataplex.storageDataReader.title: Dataplex Storage Data Reader
roles/dataplex.storageDataReader.desc: Read only access to data. Should not be used directly. This role is granted by Dataplex to managed resources like Cloud Storage buckets, BigQuery datasets etc.

roles/dataplex.storageDataWriter.title: Dataplex Storage Data Writer
roles/dataplex.storageDataWriter.desc: Write access to data. Should not be used directly. This role is granted by Dataplex to managed resources like Cloud Storage buckets, BigQuery datasets etc.

roles/dataplex.taxonomyAdmin.title: Dataplex Taxonomy Administrator
roles/dataplex.taxonomyAdmin.desc: Full access to DataTaxonomy, DataAttribute resources.

roles/dataplex.taxonomyViewer.title: Dataplex Taxonomy Viewer
roles/dataplex.taxonomyViewer.desc: Read access on DataTaxonomy, DataAttribute resources.

roles/dataplex.viewer.title: Dataplex Viewer
roles/dataplex.viewer.desc: Read access to Dataplex Universal Catalog resources, except for catalog resources like entries, entry groups, and glossaries.
